nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: Oh no! I can't find my bouquet anywhere! I had it just a moment ago...

nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: I think I left it near the fountain in the garden. Could you find it for me?

nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: Thank you so much! I think it's somewhere near the fountain area.

nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: Oh... okay. Come back if you change your mind!

nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: Any luck finding my bouquet? I think it was near the fountain...

nodes.speaker: Lou
nodes.text: My bouquet looks so beautiful! Thank you for finding it! This wedding is going to be perfect!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Welcome to our wedding! I'm so glad you could make it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Feel free to explore and talk to everyone. There's a lot to see and do!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And don't forget to sign the guestbook before you leave!

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: Hey there! Think you know Ben and Lou pretty well?

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: I've got a little trivia challenge for you! Answer my questions about the happy couple!

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: Alright, let's see what you know!

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: No worries! Come back when you're ready for the challenge!

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: Ready to try the trivia again?

nodes.speaker: Best Man
nodes.text: You really know Ben and Lou! Great job on that trivia!

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: Oh thank goodness you're here! The ring bearer dropped the rings somewhere!

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: I need you to find both wedding rings before the ceremony! I think they rolled off in different directions...

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: Check near the tables and around the garden! They could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: Please hurry back! We need those rings!

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: Have you found the rings yet? Keep looking near the tables and garden!

nodes.speaker: Maid of Honor
nodes.text: You found both rings! You're a lifesaver! The ceremony can go on!

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: Oh hello, dear! Come sit with me for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: I have some wonderful memories of Ben and Lou I'd love to share. Would you like to hear them?

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: I remember the first time Ben brought Lou home for the holidays. They were both so nervous!

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: But by the end of dinner, it felt like Lou had always been part of the family.

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: And then there was the time they tried to bake a cake together for my birthday...

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: Let's just say the fire department was NOT amused! But the thought was sweet.

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: I always knew they were meant for each other. You can see it in the way they look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: I'm so happy to be here today. Thank you for listening to an old woman's stories!

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: That's alright, dear. Come back anytime. I'm not going anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: Come, sit! Let me tell you more stories...

nodes.speaker: Grandma
nodes.text: Thank you for listening to my stories, dear. This is such a beautiful day!
You found Lou's bouquet! It's a beautiful arrangement of roses and lilies.
You found one of the wedding rings! It was hiding under a table. One more to go!
You found the second ring! It was caught in the bushes. Take them back to the Maid of Honor!
A beautiful guestbook sits open on the stand. Would you like to sign it?
A wooden sign reads: 'Welcome to Ben & Lou's Wedding! Explore, have fun, and don't forget to sign the guestbook!'
A magnificent three-tier wedding cake! It's decorated with delicate sugar flowers and topped with two tiny figures.
A beautiful stone fountain. Coins glitter at the bottom - looks like guests have been making wishes!
